scaling.normalEnemies: scale primarily with elapsed run time
scaling.bossesAndMinibosses: scale with both elapsed time and player level
scaling.hpTimesLevel: The 'HP x Level' property multiplies enemy health by the player's level, applied once at spawn; it is not updated if the player levels while the enemy lives.
scaling.curse: increases enemy Max Health, MoveSpeed and spawn frequency; health multiplier applies to newly spawned enemies only
scaling.hyperMode: increases minimum enemies spawned and enemy move speed; may increase max health
scaling.endlessMode: enemies gain 100% of base Max Health per cycle
scaling.inverseMode: enemies start at +200% HP and gain +5% HP and +0.5 move speed per minute

chests.contents: a random weapon or passive item the player already owns, levelled up by one; plus gold; plus an evolution/union when its requirements are met
